parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Cell **D** and cell **E** are in the same stage of the cell cycle.
State the difference between the nucleus of cell **D** and cell **E**.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Name the stage of mitosis occurring in each of cells **A**, **B** and **C**.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Cells **F** and **G** are newly formed cells. Cytokinesis has occurred with the formation of a cell plate.
Describe the events that have occurred in the stage of mitosis immediately **before** cytokinesis.
